case_name: Over budget or beyond the free tier
title: Explain Free Tier Resolution Limits
tests: Checks that the agent explains the 480p free-video limit without promising native 4K, disguising an upscale, or generating prematurely.

checks.name: says it is beyond the free tier
got:

- **Length:** 5 seconds is fine. The two free video models, LTX 2.5 and MiniMax H3, both allow it.

must_haves.item: The response clearly says native 4K video generation is not available on the free tier.
must_haves.why: It states 4K can't be had on the free tier and that a 4K request would be refused.

must_haves.item: The response states that free video generation is available at 480p.
must_haves.why: It says the free maximum is 480p and offers a 480p version.

must_haves.item: The response explains that the requested 5-second duration fits the free limit of up to 10 seconds per clip.
must_haves.why: It says 5 seconds is fine on both free models but never gives the 10-second per-clip limit.

must_haves.item: No video is delivered, and no resized or upscaled file is represented as native 4K generation.
must_haves.why: Nothing was generated, and it says upscaling is paid-only rather than presenting any upscale as 4K.

reply.summary: The agent correctly refused free 4K, offered 480p and generated nothing, but it never mentioned the 10-second free clip limit.
